Subject: Vendor registration + mandatory PO fields for Redwood Inference

Hi Jonas,

We're starting the vendor onboarding for Redwood so we can issue POs and set up electronic payments. Attached is HeroCorp's AP registration form — please complete and return. Before we kick off I wanted to flag a couple of mandatory PO/invoice requirements from our side that you should confirm with your finance team: 

- PO must contain a line-level product description and quantity (free-text lines are not accepted).
- PO number format: HC-YYYY-##### (this must be printed on the PDF invoice and the invoice file name).
- VAT ID or EU reverse-charge indicator on any invoice where supplier claims reverse charge (field on invoice: "VAT handling: REVERSE CHARGE").
- Remit-to bank details (IBAN + SWIFT) and a remit email for remittance advices.
- If you plan to submit invoices via our portal, please include the GL code (6-digit) and project code (optional).

We also need one of the following vendor tax docs depending on your entity: EU VAT registration certificate (if VAT-registered) OR EU self-cert for reverse-charge eligibility OR W-8/W-9 for US tax residency. If you can return the AP form and at least one tax doc, we can provision the account.

Attachment: HeroCorp-AP-form.pdf (PDF, 220 KB)

Thanks,
Marta
Finance Operations — HeroCorp

Jonas / Laura / team — thanks for the fast follow-up. A few clarifications from AP and supplier onboarding: 

- Reverse charge is acceptable. We need the VAT ID on the vendor record and the invoice must contain an explicit field/line that reads exactly: "VAT handling: REVERSE CHARGE" so our parser flags it.
- For automated ingest (portal or SFTP) the required metadata fields are: PO Number (HC-YYYY-#####), Invoice Date, Invoice Total, Currency, VAT Amount (if any), VAT handling flag, Vendor VAT ID, Remit IBAN/SWIFT, GL Code (6 digits).
- If you attach a sample invoice and complete the AP form we will provision your vendor record and issue the first PO. Please also attach the bank confirmation copy (IBAN + SWIFT) and a contact for payment escalations.

Attached: sample-po-requirements.txt (TXT, 3 KB) showing the exact field names our portal expects. We will accept PDF invoices named either as HC-2026-01234_Redwood.pdf or Redwood_HC-2026-01234.pdf — both are fine.

Thanks,
Marta
